name: duekeeper
description: DueKeeper - track deadlines, get reminded, stay ahead

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix web start"
